children: QuickLogic's revenue rose 153% year over year, while its net loss narrowed from $4.0 million to $2.2 million. The revenue increase primarily reflected higher eFPGA IP and professional services revenue, including work under the Strategic Radiation Hardened FPGA Technology U.S. government contract and additional eFPGA IP contracts.
